what: Clean-room drivability grounding of the released opencode-worker SKILL.md: can a cold agent, given ONLY this one file and nothing else in the repo, drive the live worker and honest-grade the result? This is the skill-file test, distinct from the worker's task-capability grade (packs/<target>/grade.json).
method: Fresh general-purpose agent per run (not a fork), handed only skills/opencode-worker/SKILL.md and the live-env entry facts (server url, agent name, model ids, workdir-root rule). It delegates a small independently-verifiable task to the worker and grades by its OWN execution, never the worker's DONE. API-fact findings route to this source file; a fix is not proven until re-grounded.
target: qwen3.8-27b Q6_K on opencode serve v2, live

runs.independent_check: 7/7 assertions pass on the real file
gaps_found: endpoint paths written bare (POST /session ...), /api prefix only in prose: a literal receiver would 404
permission-ask entry shape (its id field) assumed, not stated

runs.caught: the run-1 message-shape gap report was itself wrong (that agent had probed defensively). Coding strictly to my applied fix (info wrapper / parts) stalled turn-state detection. Live API truth: fields are TOP-LEVEL (no info wrapper), parts array is named content, not parts. This matches the long-standing CLAUDE.md facts; my edit had introduced a correctness bug, now reverted to reality.

runs.independent_check: 6/6 assertions pass on the real file
confirmed_against_live_api: type/finish/time.created at item TOP LEVEL (no info wrapper)
reply text in the content list (type==text), not parts
permission ask id used as the reply path segment (HTTP 204)
runs.remaining_gaps: none that blocked or forced a guess

verdict: A cold session following only the SKILL.md drives the live worker to a correct, honest-graded build. Three fixes earned by grounding are folded into the source and the qwen variant: (1) /api path prefix, (2) explicit message shape (top-level fields + content parts), (3) permission-ask id. The worker's own task capability (not this file's drivability) is graded separately in packs/qwen3.8-27b__q6_k__opencode/.
